title: Omg I just stumbled upon this sub
content: So I had no idea this was a thing….I have a place I go in my dreams and it’s very specific and exactly the same in every dream. The basements are heavily tiled like an old scary hospital and the lighting is green. There’s really messed up people in the rooms and it’s like they live there because they need to be institutionalized. The main floors are like a galleria of stores and restaurants and such and to the south east there’s a water park. I usually start at an airport and fly there but it’s like I only fly over a fence and it takes like 20 seconds to get there.
